title: Living-City Urban Metabolism and Synergy Ledger
description: Versioned comparison contract for bounded urban energy, exergy, water, material, emissions, thermal-comfort, and service flows. It deliberately has no overall city-goodness score.

nutrient_assessments.description: Optional versioned, source-scoped nutrient portfolio assessment envelopes emitted by Symtropy or synthetic contract controls. Absence is not zero nutrition supply.

distributional_impacts.description: Optional cohort-disaggregated outcome changes against an explicit baseline. Assessment records require at least one entry. These records expose incidence and declared-floor breaches; they are not a permission to optimize away harms.

distributional_coverage.description: Required for real assessments: records the declared population frame, represented cohort refs, known omissions, intersectional review state, and evidence. It documents coverage; it does not prove no group was missed.

causal_evaluations.description: Optional review-gated interpretation records. Interaction arithmetic remains descriptive unless an explicitly documented causal design, resolved evidence, falsification checks, and review justify a stronger claim. Schema validity alone never certifies causality.

calibration_receipts.description: Per-model, per-metric calibration receipts evaluated on data disjoint from training. Pass status requires the confidence interval for empirical interval coverage to fit wholly inside a predeclared tolerance band; schema validity alone does not prove the physical model is valid.

beneficiary_scope_ref.description: Stable aggregate or pseudonymous beneficiary-scope ID; never embed a person's name or direct identifier.

delivery_period_ref.description: Stable reporting-period ID used to compare delivered edible food on the same temporal basis.

nutrient_assessment_refs.description: References to nutrient assessment envelopes in nutrient_assessments; optional, and absence never implies zero nutrient supply.

calibration_receipt_refs.description: Resolved calibration receipt IDs that support calibration_status; all material model-output metrics must have a passing receipt before the run is called calibrated/validated.

producer_revision.description: Exact Symtropy source revision; required for symtropy_output receipts.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact serialized Symtropy NutrientPortfolioAssessmentV1 payload; the hash is only a declared commitment until those bytes are independently checked.

payload_ref.description: Location or immutable artifact identifier for the exact serialized native payload. Offline verification supports repository-relative files only via repo-file:<relative-posix-path>; absolute paths, parent traversal, and paths resolving outside the repository are rejected. Other locators remain unverified unless a separate trusted resolver retrieves and verifies their bytes.

scenario_id.description: Intervention scenario whose outcome is being compared.

baseline_scenario_ref.description: Must resolve to the explicitly designated baseline scenario.

affected_group_ref.description: Stable aggregate or pseudonymous cohort reference; do not embed a person's name or direct identifier.

constraint_ref.description: Source or governance reference for the non-compensatory floor. Required and evidence-backed when the floor has been evaluated.

population_frame.description: Defined population/area/service frame for this distributional review; include period and scope.

group_identification_method.description: How potentially affected groups were identified, including participation or data limitations.

included_group_refs.description: Stable cohort refs represented in the distributional impact ledger. References must not encode personal identifiers.

known_omissions.description: Known groups, impacts, or intersections not covered. An empty array means none identified by the declared review method, not proof of completeness.

omission_review_method.description: How likely omissions and unrepresented populations were considered.

review_ref.description: Evidence-catalogue reference to the independent design/evidence review; a status string alone is not proof of review.

reviewer_role.description: Declared role of the reviewer. This declaration is not an identity credential; independent review must be supported by a separately resolvable review record.

nominal_coverage_bp.description: Nominal predictive-interval coverage in basis points, e.g. 9500 = 95%.

interval_method.description: v0.1 implements a Wilson interval and requires one independent scored outcome per independent unit; dependent time/space series need a separately specified block/cluster method.
